item.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre dans le désordre après les résultats des banques
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en ordre dispersé mardi alors que les investisseurs analysent les premiers résultats trimestriels des entreprises avec le coup d'envoi donné par les grandes banques américaines.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en ordre dispersé mardi alors que les investisseurs analysent les premiers résultats trimestriels des entreprises avec le coup d'envoi donné par les grandes banques américaines. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 415,92 points, soit 0,80%, à 52.266,47 points. Le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, recule de 6,81 points, soit 0,09%, à 7.800,43 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cède 103,37 points, soit 0,38%, à 27.142,54 points. Le Dow Jones surperforme les deux autres indices de Wall Street qui sont pénalisés par une nouvelle baisse des grandes valeurs technologiques à la suite d'informations selon lesquelles le groupe chinois ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) est en mesure de bousculer le secteur des puces mémoire et de réduire rapidement l'écart technologique avec ses concurrents occidentaux. Le Dow Jones est soutenu notamment par [USN:L6N45Z0QI TEXT:"Goldman Sachs"] (GS.N) (+1,36%) qui a fait état d'une hausse de son bénéfice au troisième trimestre, grâce à une activité de fusions-acquisitions soutenue et à une augmentation des revenus issus du trading. [USN:L6N45Z0Q5 TEXT:"JPMorgan Chase"] (JPM.N) avance de 1,11%, tandis que [USN:L6N45Z0PC TEXT:"Wells Fargo"] (WFC.N) et [USN:L6N45Z0TZ TEXT:"Citigroup"] (C.N) reculent respectivement de 1,14% et 3,71% après leurs résultats trimestriels. Dans la santé, [USN:L6N45Z0RB TEXT:"Johnson & Johnson"] (JNJ.N) cède 0,98% malgré un bénéfice trimestriel meilleur que prévu. UnitedHealth (UNH.N) prend 1,49% après avoir revu à la hausse sa prévision de bénéfice pour 2026, grâce à une réduction des dépenses de santé et à une amélioration des marges dans certaines divisions. La perspective d'une saison des résultats solide a récemment soutenu l'ensemble du marché boursier américain, dans un contexte marqué par des inquiétudes géopolitiques croissantes, la flambée des rendements des obligations d'État et les craintes inflationnistes. Les bénéfices des sociétés du S&P 500 (.SPX) pour le trimestre juillet-septembre devraient progresser de 30,6%, les entreprises des secteurs de la technologie et de l'énergie étant celles qui devraient enregistrer les plus fortes hausses, selon les données compilées par LSEG. Dans le compartiment technologique, les fabricants américains de puces électroniques subissent de nouveau des pressions à la baisse après la vague de ventes de lundi. Le géant des semi-conducteurs Nvidia (NVDA.O) recule de 0,50%, tandis qu'AMD (AMD.O) et Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) perdent respectivement 1,05% et 2,36%. Le fabricant de puces mémoire Micron Technology (MU.O) chute de 4,21%, tandis que les sociétés de stockage de données comme Western Digital (WDC.O) , Seagate (STX.O) et Sandisk (SNDK.O) cèdent entre 3,61% et 5,84%. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L8N45Z0O4]

item.title: Jerry Jones: Cowboys DC Christian Parker not 'overwhelmed'
item.description: Christian Parker is shifting to the coaching box from the field as the Cowboys add Mike Pettine to the staff as a consultant, but owner Jerry Jones denies his 32-year-old defensive coordinator is "overwhelmed."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Christian Parker is shifting to the coaching box from the field as the Cowboys add Mike Pettine to the staff as a consultant, but owner Jerry Jones denies his 32-year-old defensive coordinator is "overwhelmed." "I'm obviously disappointed in the results so far," Jones said Tuesday on his weekly radio spot on 105.3 FM in Dallas. The results are near the bottom of the barrel among NFL defenses through five games. The Cowboys rank 31st in total defense, allowing 395.4 yards per game, and 25th in scoring defense at 27.2 points per game. Parker worked under Pettine as a defensive quality control coach in Green Bay in 2019-20 and current Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer was on the same coaching staff as Pettine with the Jets. Schottenheimer said Pettine was one of two consultants the Cowboys considered hiring, but wasn't willing to share the other coach. Pettine's most recent gig was a support role for Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores. Minnesota leads the NFL in blitz percentage, creating pressure consistently without a dominant individual edge rusher. The Vikings (5-0) lead the NFL in sacks with 16. Jones said Tuesday the Pettine hire centered around the existing working relationship with both coaches and noted the adjustment period to changes in coaches, personnel and scheme on defense was largely expected. "You put that all together and you've got some work to do to putting that all in place relative to the challenges you have when you really get into the ballgames," Jones told 105.3 FM on Tuesday. Jones' on-camera reaction to the Cowboys' struggles against undrafted rookie free agent quarterback Jalon Daniels and the Buccaneers tells a slightly different story. And the move to add Pettine to the coaching staff seemingly underscores the sense of concern over lagging performance for the Cowboys as they prepare to travel to Green Bay for a Sunday night date with the Packers. Pettine was given the title of senior defensive assistant. His role will be evolving starting with this week's game plan at Green Bay, one of Pettine's stops as a defensive coordinator. He coached current Cowboys defenders Kenny Clark and Rashan Gary with the Packers. He also had stints as defensive coordinator of the Jets and Bills and was head coach of the Cleveland Browns Schottenheimer said he's "coming into the situation where he will be very comfortable and can help very quickly." --Field Level Media

item.title: Prysmian completa acquisizione Xtera, spinge su cavi sottomarini tlc
item.description: Prysmian ha completato l'acquisizione di Xtera Topco Limited, gruppo con base nel Regno Unito e negli Stati Uniti attivo nei sistemi chiavi in mano per le telecomunicazioni sottomarine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prysmian (PRY.MI) ha completato l'acquisizione di Xtera Topco Limited, gruppo con base nel Regno Unito e negli Stati Uniti attivo nei sistemi chiavi in mano per le telecomunicazioni sottomarine. Lo ha comunicato la società con una nota, sottolineando che l'operazione rafforza l'espansione del gruppo nel settore delle telecomunicazioni sottomarine. L'operazione è realizzata in joint venture tra Prysmian (80%) e Fincantieri (20%). L'accordo del dicembre 2025 attribuisce a Xtera un enterprise value di 65 milioni di dollari Prysmian sottolinea inoltre che Xtera è stata recentemente scelta da EXA Infrastructure per il progetto EXA Meridian, un nuovo collegamento transatlantico di 6.552 chilometri tra New Jersey e Regno Unito. I cavi saranno prodotti nel sito di Nordenham, in Germania, dove il gruppo sta raddoppiando la capacità produttiva e prevede fino a 300 nuove assunzioni.

item.title: Striking unions and Centinela copper mine restart negotiations
item.description: Chile's Centinela copper mine and two striking unions returned to the negotiating table on Tuesday under a voluntary mediation process aimed at resolving a week-long work stoppage that workers say is affecting operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chile's Centinela copper mine and two striking unions returned to the negotiating table on Tuesday under a voluntary mediation process aimed at resolving a week-long work stoppage that workers say is affecting operations. The Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions began the stoppage last Wednesday after collective contract negotiations with mine owner Antofagasta Minerals (ANTO.L) failed. The unions are seeking equal benefits for all workers, regardless of union affiliation. "Regarding operational activity, the reports the unions have had access to confirm a direct impact," the unions said in a statement, adding that the number of trucks operating at the mine had been cut in half because of the strike. The Distrito Centinela and Minera Esperanza unions say their members account for more than 50% of the critical mine operators, including shovel and drill operators, and more than 60% of mining equipment maintenance workers. According to the unions, the full impact of the strike is expected to be felt in November, when [USN:L1N45U10J TEXT:"production could fall by half"]. When the strike began, Antofagasta Minerals said the striking workers accounted for 22% of the mine's total workforce and projected production would remain unchanged.

item.title: Sottotono in seduta volatile dopo risultati banche, giù i chip
item.description: I principali indici di Wall Street sono sottotono in una seduta caratterizzata da forti oscillazioni, con i titoli dei chip nuovamente sotto pressione a causa delle vendite, mentre gli investitori analizzano una serie di risultati trimestrali contrastanti, compresi quelli delle grandi banche statunitensi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I principali indici di Wall Street sono sottotono in una seduta caratterizzata da forti oscillazioni, con i titoli dei chip nuovamente sotto pressione a causa delle vendite, mentre gli investitori analizzano una serie di risultati trimestrali contrastanti, compresi quelli delle grandi banche statunitensi. ** Nell’indice S&P 500, il comparto healthcare (.SPXHC) rappresenta il principale freno, con JOHNSON & JOHNSON (JNJ.N) che perde il 5,4% nonostante utili trimestrali superiori alle attese. ** Anche il settore dei finanziari (.SPSY) contribuisce al clima negativo: WELLS FARGO (WFC.N) cede l'1,1% dopo che il proprio margine di interesse netto è risultato inferiore alle stime, mentre JPMORGAN CHASE (JPM.N) oscilla tra rialzi e ribassi a seguito di un raro mancato raggiungimento degli obiettivi di profitto. ** CITIGROUP (C.N) perde l’1,9%, mentre GOLDMAN SACHS (GS.N) guadagna circa l’1% dopo che entrambe hanno superato le stime. L’assicuratore sanitario UNITEDHEALTH (UNH.N) arretra dello 0,8%, invertendo la rotta. ** Alle 17.20 italiane l’indice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) cede lo 0,12% a 51.788,70, l’S&P 500 (.SPX) perde lo 0,13% a 7.797,65 e il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) scende dello 0,19% a 27.193,55. ** Il rialzo del 3% di META (META.O) sostiene il settore dei servizi di comunicazione (.SPLRCL) , limitando le perdite dell’S&P 500. Il +2% di SALESFORCE (CRM.N) contiene il calo del Dow. ** Tra i singoli titoli, BUMBLE (BMBL.O) balza del 56% toccando il massimo di un anno dopo che la società dell’app di incontri ha accettato il delisting in un'operazione da 1,3 miliardi di dollari.

item.title: Apple lança novos produtos para casa inteligente com Siri atualizada
item.description: A Apple lançou nesta terça-feira uma série de produtos inteligentes, incluindo um dispositivo semelhante ao iPad chamado HomeView, apostando que sua assistente virtual Siri, aprimorada com IA, possa ajudar a empresa a conquistar uma fatia maior do mercado de casas conectadas.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: A Apple (AAPL.O) lançou nesta terça-feira uma série de produtos inteligentes, incluindo um dispositivo semelhante ao iPad chamado HomeView, apostando que sua assistente virtual Siri, aprimorada com IA, possa ajudar a empresa a conquistar uma fatia maior do mercado de casas conectadas. O dispositivo HomeView, cujo preço inicial é de US$299 e cujas entregas começam no próximo mês, é a mais recente incursão da Apple no mercado altamente competitivo de dispositivos domésticos conectados. Ele contará com uma tela de 7 polegadas e reconhecimento facial, ajudando os usuários a controlar campainhas, termostatos e fechaduras inteligentes em um mercado no qual a Apple vem atuando há uma década sem grande sucesso. A empresa está lançando os produtos enquanto tenta se defender de rivais, incluindo concorrentes tradicionais como a Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , que investiu pesadamente em seus alto-falantes Echo e campainhas Ring. Na semana passada, a Amazon também lançou tablets premium. Novas empresas emergentes de IA, como a OpenAI, têm suas próprias ambições no setor de hardware. “A Apple precisa demonstrar que seus recursos de IA podem oferecer benefícios significativos além dos comandos de voz básicos, simplificando tarefas cotidianas e trazendo mais inteligência para o lar”, disse Paolo Pescatore, analista da PP Foresight. “A oportunidade é considerável, dada sua vasta base instalada, mas a confiabilidade, a confiança e a facilidade de uso determinarão, em última instância, se os consumidores adotarão esses recursos”, acrescentou. “A IA por si só não será suficiente para convencer as famílias a investirem em mais dispositivos.” Investidores estão analisando mais de perto as vendas de hardware da Apple em busca de crescimento, já que a receita de serviços da empresa vem sofrendo pressão regulatória. A Apple aprimorou os recursos da Siri com a ajuda do Google, mas analistas afirmaram que não está claro se sua assistente de IA é competitiva o suficiente para atrair consumidores para um mercado saturado de dispositivos domésticos conectados. Os lançamentos também coincidem com preocupações crescentes de que dispositivos conectados, incluindo geladeiras e TVs inteligentes, possam ser vulneráveis a hackers. RECURSOS ADICIONAIS O lançamento do HomeView da Apple foi acompanhado por atualizações em seu alto-falante inteligente HomePod e nos dispositivos Apple TV. A empresa também apresentou uma linha de acessórios, incluindo campainhas, câmeras e termostatos, fabricados pela LG e pela Schneider Electric e projetados com a ajuda da Apple. “É interessante ver a Apple fazendo parceria com a LG e a Schneider, já que normalmente ela gosta de ter controle total sobre o hardware que vende”, disse Ben Wood, cofundador da CCS Insight. “No entanto, olhando mais de perto, parece que houve uma colaboração muito profunda entre a Apple e esses parceiros para garantir que o design, a engenharia e a experiência correspondam exatamente ao que os usuários esperariam da Apple.” Durante um vídeo de demonstração do dispositivo, a Apple mostrou o HomeView -- que foi projetado para ser pendurado na parede ou apoiado sobre uma mesa -- e sua assistente virtual Siri atendendo a comandos de voz de vários membros de uma família ao mesmo tempo. O dispositivo HomeView não será vendido na União Europeia, pois a IA da Siri continua indisponível na região devido às regulamentações locais, informou a Apple. A empresa lançou pela primeira vez seu aplicativo Home para controlar dispositivos inteligentes em 2016, seguido pelos alto-falantes inteligentes HomePod em 2018, mas essas ofertas estão competindo com os alto-falantes Google Home da Alphabet (GOOGL.O) e a linha Echo da Amazon. Analistas afirmaram que dois grandes desafios para a Apple eram fazer com que seus dispositivos funcionassem com uma variedade de aparelhos de terceiros e a capacidade limitada da Siri de fornecer respostas úteis. “A maioria dos alto-falantes e hubs inteligentes nas residências hoje são dispositivos de baixo custo que não conseguem executar IA na borda, portanto, estão prontos para serem substituídos”, disse Mohit Agrawal, diretor de pesquisa da Counterpoint. “Amazon e Google mal começaram a atualizar seus hardwares para o Alexa+ e o Gemini, então o ciclo de atualização está totalmente aberto, e a Apple quer vencer essa disputa.” O preço de US$299 do HomeView da Apple está acima do Echo Show 8 da Amazon, que custa US$199,99, e do Nest Hub do Google, que custa US$99,99. A nova Apple TV 4K chega ao mercado por US$299, mais do que o dobro do preço de seu antecessor e em linha com o Shield TV Pro da Nvidia, enquanto as ofertas concorrentes da Amazon, do Google e da Roku custam US$200 ou menos. As ações da Apple subiam mais de 1% nesta tarde de terça-feira pelo horário de Brasília.

item.title: Brasil anuncia proyecto de ley para condonar deuda de 2.500 millones de dólares a microempresarios
item.description: El gobierno brasileño anunció el martes que presentaría un proyecto de ley al Congreso destinado a condonar la deuda de los microempresarios con el Estado y añadió que el objetivo es hacer frente a una deuda de unos 12.600 millones de reales (2.510 millones de dólares).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El gobierno brasileño anunció el martes que presentaría un proyecto de ley al Congreso destinado a condonar la deuda de los microempresarios con el Estado y añadió que el objetivo es hacer frente a una deuda de unos 12.600 millones de reales (2.510 millones de dólares). El Gobierno del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva añadió en un comunicado que también iba a poner en marcha un programa para adquirir la deuda de los microempresarios con el sector privado. Los microempresarios (MEI) constituyen una categoría empresarial brasileña simplificada creada por el Gobierno para formalizar a los trabajadores autónomos, como los repartidores de comida y los conductores de servicios de transporte compartido, así como a los propietarios de pequeñas empresas. El Gobierno señaló que la condonación de la deuda beneficiaría a unos 3,6 millones de MEI, mientras que el programa de compra tendría como objetivo adquirir unos 6.000 millones de reales en deuda con descuentos de al menos el 90%. Las medidas tienen como objetivo crear las condiciones para la expansión de las actividades económicas de los MEI, añadió El anuncio se produce menos de dos semanas antes de la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales, a la que Lula aparece detrás del senador derechista Flávio Bolsonaro en las encuestas. "Nadie quiere ser un MEI toda su vida, la gente quiere crecer; corresponde al Gobierno proporcionar las condiciones", afirmó Lula en una ceremonia celebrada el martes para anunciar las medidas.

item.title: Goldman CEO watching for election-driven volatility around data centers
item.description: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday it would be interesting to watch for political volatility around AI centers ahead of midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Saeed Azhar, Pritam Biswas
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs (GS.N) CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday it would be interesting to watch for political volatility around AI centers ahead of midterm elections . Speaking at an analysts' call for quarterly earnings, he also said as the financing needs for AI projects grow and there is pressure on rates, it could affect the returns and the viability of certain projects. "Localized political volatility around data centers. You know, we've got an election coming up. It'll be interesting to see," Solomon said. "Obviously there's a lot of political discussion coming into an election, but then you also have to see how states and localities act coming out of elections. All these things can create you know volatility, and there's uncertainty around them." Data centers, which provide the computing power needed to train and run AI models, [USN:L1N43H17Q TEXT:"have faced growing opposition from communities across the United States"]. Residents have raised concerns about their rising electricity demand, the potential for higher utility bills and other environmental impacts on local communities. The artificial intelligence buildout is on track to require a larger share of U.S. output than the rollout of electricity, railroads, interstate highways or the internet, with an increasingly complicated financial structure that poses potentially systemic risks, according to a new study. The expansion will consume around 3.6% of gross domestic product annually through 2032, or more than $10 trillion, and is using ever more intricate financing arrangements, Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, a finance and real estate professor at Columbia Business School, [USN:L6N45F0VB TEXT:"wrote in a paper prepared for a Brookings Institution conference last month"]. "There's going to be infrastructure built around it that's going to be quite significant," Goldman's Solomon. "But we feel very well positioned to bring the full range of services and participate actively, and we still see an enormous amount of activity." Goldman is a financial partner with Nvidia (NVDA.O) , which in August announced it has partnered with six major financial institutions to launch compute platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure.

item.title: Wall Street tem variações moderadas em pregão volátil após balanços de grandes bancos
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street apresentavam variações moderadas em um pregão volátil nesta terça-feira, com as ações do setor de chips voltando a sofrer pressão de venda, enquanto os investidores analisavam resultados corporativos trimestrais mistos, incluindo os dos grandes bancos norte-americanos.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street apresentavam variações moderadas em um pregão volátil nesta terça-feira, com as ações do setor de chips voltando a sofrer pressão de venda, enquanto os investidores analisavam resultados corporativos trimestrais mistos, incluindo os dos grandes bancos norte-americanos. No S&P 500, as ações do setor de saúde (.SPXHC) eram as que mais pesavam, com a Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) perdendo 4,8%, apesar de ter superado as estimativas de lucro trimestral. O setor financeiro (.SPSY) contribuía para o clima de pessimismo, com o Wells Fargo (WFC.N) caindo 2,5% depois que sua receita líquida de juros ficou abaixo das estimativas, e o JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) oscilando entre ganhos e perdas após um raro resultado abaixo do esperado. O Citigroup (C.N) recuava 1,8%, mas o Goldman Sachs (GS.N) subia cerca de 1% depois que ambos superaram as estimativas. A seguradora de saúde UnitedHealth (UNH.N) também caía 0,2%, revertendo seu curso. O achatamento da curva de juros — em que os rendimentos de prazo mais longo sobem mais rapidamente do que os de prazo mais curto, um sinal de aumento dos riscos de crédito no futuro — pesou sobre os bancos, afirmou Kathleen Brooks, diretora de pesquisa da XTB. “Os investidores tendem a precificar isso com antecedência, e é por isso que bancos norte-americanos com grandes unidades de varejo, como o JPMorgan e o Citi, estão enfrentando dificuldades.” As esperanças de uma temporada de resultados sólidos vinham sustentando o mercado como um todo em meio a tensões geopolíticas, alta nos rendimentos dos títulos e preocupações com a inflação. Às 11h20 (horário de Brasília), o Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 9,14 pontos, ou 0,02%, para 51.859,69, o S&P 500 (.SPX) recuava 6,36 pontos, ou 0,08%, para 7.800,86, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) caía 32,52 pontos, ou 0,12%, para 27.213,38. As ações do setor de tecnologia da informação caíam, pressionando o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq. As ações de fabricantes de chips foram as mais afetadas após relatos de avanços tecnológicos da empresa chinesa CXMT. A concorrência da China “pode tirar parte dos negócios de algumas das empresas mais conhecidas, mas não acho que vá tirar todos os negócios”, disse Robert Pavlik, gerente sênior de portfólio da Dakota Wealth. A fabricante de chips de memória Micron Technology (MU.O) caía 4,5%, enquanto as empresas de armazenamento de dados Western Digital (WDC.O) , Seagate (STX.O) e Sandisk (SNDK.O) registravam quedas de entre 2% e 5%. O índice mais amplo de chips (.SOX) perdia 1,5%, no que Pavlik chamou de “realização de lucros em massa”. Uma alta de 3% na meta (META.O) impulsionava o setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) , limitando as perdas no S&P 500. O ganho de 3% da Salesforce (CRM.N) continha a queda do Dow.

item.title: イエメン首都サヌアの石油施設に攻撃＝フーシ派系メディア
item.description: [カイロ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ　１３日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が運営するアルマシラ・テレビは１３日、イエメンの首都サヌアにあるイエメン石油会社の施設が攻撃を受けたと報じた。

これに先立ち、サウジアラビア主導の連合軍は、サヌアにあるイエメン石油会社のサバハ中央給油所について、安全確保のため周辺住民に退避するよう呼びかけていた。

フーシ派のサリーア軍報道官は、サヌアに対するいかなる攻撃もサウジの首都リヤドに対する「厳しく痛烈な」報復を招くと警告。フーシ派はサウジ国営石油会社サウジアラムコの石油施設は自らの攻撃対象として正当化されると主張し、従業員や民間人に対しアラムコの施設に近づかないよう呼びかけている。

item.title: Wall Street opera con pocos cambios en sesión volátil tras resultados de grandes bancos
item.description: Los principales índices de Wall Street cotizaban con pocos cambios en una jornada de altibajos el martes, ya que las acciones del sector de los semiconductores volvían a sufrir presiones vendedoras, mientras los inversores analizaban unos resultados trimestrales dispares, entre los que se incluían los de los grandes bancos estadounidenses.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Los principales índices de Wall Street cotizaban con pocos cambios en una jornada de altibajos el martes, ya que las acciones del sector de los semiconductores volvían a sufrir presiones vendedoras, mientras los inversores analizaban unos resultados trimestrales dispares, entre los que se incluían los de los grandes bancos estadounidenses. * En el S&P 500, las acciones del sector sanitario (.SPXHC) eran las que más lastraban al índice, con Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) perdiendo un 4,8% a pesar de superar las previsiones de beneficios trimestrales. * El sector financiero (.SPSY) se sumó al panorama sombrío, ya que Wells Fargo (WFC.N) caía un 2,5% después de que sus ingresos netos por intereses no alcanzaron las previsiones, y JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) oscilaba entre ganancias y pérdidas tras un inusual resultado por debajo de lo esperado. * Citigroup (C.N) cedía un 1,8%, pero Goldman Sachs (GS.N) subía alrededor de un 1% después de que ambos superaron las previsiones. La aseguradora sanitaria UnitedHealth (UNH.N) también caía un 0,2%, revirtiendo su tendencia. * El aplanamiento de la curva de rendimientos, en la que los retornos a largo plazo suben más rápido que los de corto plazo, lo que indica un aumento de los riesgos crediticios en el futuro, lastraba a los bancos, según señaló Kathleen Brooks, directora de investigación de XTB. * Las esperanzas de una sólida temporada de resultados habían estado sosteniendo al mercado en general en medio de las tensiones geopolíticas, el aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos y las preocupaciones por la inflación. * A las 1513 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) caía 36,88 puntos, o un 0,07%, a 51.813,67 unidades; el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdía 9,34 puntos, o un 0,12%, a 7.797,90 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) bajaba 52,30 puntos, o un 0,19%, a 27.193,60 unidades. * Las acciones del sector de las tecnologías de la información registraban caídas, lo que ejercía presión sobre el S&P 500 y el Nasdaq. Las de las empresas de semiconductores eran las más afectadas tras los reportes sobre los avances tecnológicos de la empresa china CXMT. * El fabricante de chips de memoria Micron Technology (MU.O) caía un 4,5%, mientras que las empresas de almacenamiento de datos Western Digital (WDC.O) , Seagate (STX.O) y Sandisk (SNDK.O) perdían entre el 2% y el 5%. El índice general de chips (.SOX) cedía un 1,5%. * Una subida del 3% en Meta (META.O) impulsaba al sector de los servicios de comunicación (.SPLRCL) , lo que limitaba las pérdidas del S&P 500. La subida del 3% de Salesforce (CRM.N) frenaba el descenso del Dow.

item.title: Report: Dodge close to making its return to Cup Series
item.description: Dodge is "very close" to finalizing its return to the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, The Athletic reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dodge is "very close" to finalizing its return to the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, The Athletic reported on Tuesday. Negotiations are ongoing but sources said Dodge is on track to participate in the season-opening Daytona 500 on Feb. 21. Dodge, which last raced in the Cup Series in 2012, will join Ford, Chevrolet and Toyota as the circuit's fourth manufacturer. Kaulig Racing, which currently fields two Chevrolets in the Cup Series, is expected to switch to Dodge, per the report. Kaulig Racing uses Ram Trucks in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, and Ram Trucks and Dodge are both owned by the parent company Stellantis North America. Dodge also is in the process of finalizing a partnership with ECR Engines to at least temporarily supply its engines for the Cup Series, per The Athletic. ECR Engines is owned by Cup Series competitor Richard Childress Racing. Mark Rushbrook, global director of Ford Racing, told The Athletic last week that Dodge's impending return is a "good thing" for the sport. "So we certainly welcome Dodge as a fourth manufacturer," he said. "We welcome more beyond that into NASCAR. We want to compete against the best manufacturers in the world and to have more of that OEM (original engine manufacturer) rivalry on track. So certainly, if Dodge is going to come to Cup, just like Ram came to the truck, we welcome them." --Field Level Media

item.title: Albanian students protest over education, jobs, clash with police
item.description: Student protesters hurled bricks and concrete blocks at Albania's Education Ministry in Tirana on Tuesday and police fired tear gas and water cannons in response, as a nationwide demonstration over education and social issues turned violent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Student protesters hurled bricks and concrete blocks at Albania's Education Ministry in Tirana on Tuesday and police fired tear gas and water cannons in response, as a nationwide demonstration over education and social issues turned violent. Police officers detained several protesters. Student organisers said the protest was over conditions at universities, higher education costs, financial support and employment prospects after graduation. Some protesters added they wanted to express their frustration with inequality and the government. "What Albania needs is a revolution, a change, a complete overthrow of the system because it can't go on like this," protester Luljeta Kola said, adding there was deep social injustice and a gulf between rich and poor in the country. The demonstration comes amid a broader wave of student activism in Europe. In France, high school students have staged weeks of [USN:L1N45U08J TEXT:"protests"] and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education. Albania's Deputy Prime Minister Albana Koçiu wrote on Facebook: "Violence has not been, is not, and will never be a solution. Throwing stones, attacking institutions and the state police, as well as the senseless destruction of public property, are not how youth should express themselves."

item.title: MI5 chief lists Iran, Russia, AI and terrorists among threats to UK
item.description: MI5 spy chief Ken McCallum delivered his annual speech on Tuesday outlining his view of the threats to Britain, from hostile states such as Iran and Russia to the development of artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MI5 spy chief Ken McCallum [USN:L8N45Z17L TEXT:"delivered his annual speech"] on Tuesday outlining his view of the threats to Britain, from hostile states such as Iran and Russia to the development of artificial intelligence. Here is a summary of the main threats and issues he detailed in his speech and subsequent questions from media: RUSSIA McCallum called Russia, which denies involvement in hostile acts in Britain and other Western countries, "aggressor number one". He said it was escalating "hybrid" warfare, staying below the threshold that would trigger a direct NATO response. He said Russia's capabilities had been reduced by the expulsion of 1,000 officials from embassies since the invasion of Ukraine, which meant it had to rely on native volunteers and criminal proxies. IRAN Tehran is also using criminal proxies - to target opponents, Iranian media organisations and Israeli interests in Britain - and has expanded its hybrid campaign in the last year, McCallum said. He said operations connected to Iran had yielded more than 50 arrests in the UK, and that many had been aimed at Jewish communities. The other shift had been "Iranian ambitions to come at harder targets, like military sites", he said. Tehran also rejects accusations of malign activity in Britain. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE McCallum said AI was "supercharging the cybersecurity contest between attackers and defenders", producing tailored propaganda and material for individuals. MI5 has caught potential attackers using it to try to improve reconnaissance and attack methodologies. AI-enabled drones added a new challenge, he said. McCallum said the greatest concern about the misuse of AI was terrorists developing bioweapons or even creating new pathogens. AI also presented a risk in itself. "Put at its simplest, human history has given us no experience of facing an actor which is smarter than we are, is capable of out-thinking us. This is genuinely novel and deserves the serious attention it is getting." TERRORISM Britain in April raised its national terrorism threat level to "severe", meaning an attack within the next six months is highly likely. McCallum said Al Qaeda and Islamic State continued to inspire plots, and MI5 was still having to respond to attempts to carry out mass-casualty attacks. He said the most marked trend of the last year had been the increase in cases where extreme anti-immigration and anti-Muslim grievances were tipping over into terrorist intent. An investigation into one 13-year-old who had been radicalised by extreme right-wing ideology had led to an unnamed foreign partner thwarting a lethal attack on its soil, he said. BREXIT On Sunday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Russia had interfered in Britain's 2016 referendum vote to leave the European Union, something Moscow has denied. Asked about such interference, McCallum said it was public knowledge that Russian media such as Russia Today "came in pretty strongly around the time of the referendum", and there had been a certain amount of activity from trolls and bots. But he said Russian online trolling had been comparatively unimpressive.

item.title: India's Modi to visit Canada in December, Carney's office says
item.description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set visit Canada in December, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's office said on Tuesday, adding that the leaders were committed to conclude negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement at the earliest opportunity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set visit Canada in December, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's office said on Tuesday, adding that the leaders were committed to conclude negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement at the earliest opportunity. Carney and Modi spoke on Tuesday and agreed to remain in close contact ahead of the December visit, Carney's office said in a statement.

item.title: ロシア、北海道新聞記者を拘束 スパイ容疑＝報道
item.description: [モスクワ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　１３日　ロイター] - ロシア連邦保安局（ＦＳＢ）は１３日、ロシアの防衛能力に関する情報を収集していたとして、日本人記者を拘束したと発表した。ロシアの通信各社が報じた。

インタファクス通信はＦＳＢの話として、拘束された記者は北海道新聞の記者で、ロシア出国を予定していた極東サハリン州で拘束された後、首都モスクワに移送されたと報じている。モスクワの裁判所は、この記者の約２カ月間の勾留を認めたという。

この件について、在モスクワ日本大使館からコメントは得られていない。

ロシア国営テレビは、床に横たわった男性が黒い制服を着た覆面姿の３人に手錠をかけられている映像を放映。映像では、この男性がスパイ活動の疑いをかけられていると説明している。このほか、この男性がＦＳＢ職員２人に付き添われて航空機に搭乗する様子や、モスクワの裁判所で被告人用の囲いの中にいる様子も放映した。

ロシアはウクライナ侵攻を巡り西側諸国による対ロシア制裁に日本が加わったことを理由に、日本を「非友好国」と位置付けている。

item.title: Nigeria's Dangote oil refinery swings to net profit ahead of IPO
item.description: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery, which is seeking to raise $1.6 billion in what would be Africa's biggest IPO, swung to a net profit in the first nine months of 2026 as revenue more than doubled, according to unaudited results released on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Chijioke Ohuocha, Macdonald Dzirutwe
item.content:encoded: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery, which is [USN:L1N456052 TEXT:"seeking to raise"] $1.6 billion in what would be Africa's biggest IPO, swung to a net profit in the first nine months of 2026 as revenue more than doubled, according to unaudited results released on Tuesday. The company posted a net profit of $4.73 billion for January to September, compared with a $117.2 million loss a year earlier. The refinery has benefited from rising demand for its products amid supply disruptions linked to the Iran war, helping it sell jet fuel into Western Europe. "Our third-quarter performance demonstrates the successful transition from commissioning and ramp-up activities to sustainable commercial operations," Chief Executive Officer David Bird said in a statement. Revenue rose to $22.48 billion from $9.19 billion, while core earnings (EBITDA) jumped to $5.52 billion from $627.6 million, as higher crude processing rates, stronger refining margins and improved operations boosted profits. The 700,000-barrel-per-day refinery generated operating cash flow of $3.68 billion, up from $364.7 million a year earlier, and ended September with cash holdings of $6.69 billion. It also moved from a net debt position of $1.73 billion a year ago to net cash of $650.8 million. The application period for the initial public offering, initially due to close on October 13, [USN:L8N45Y14M TEXT:"has been extended"] by two weeks to October 27 amid strong investor demand. Built at a cost of about $20 billion on the outskirts of Lagos, the refinery has reshaped Nigeria's fuel market since it started operations in 2024. It aims to double refining capacity to 1.4 million bpd by 2029. The refinery has helped reduce Nigeria's reliance on imported petroleum products and has emerged as a major supplier of refined fuels to domestic and regional markets.

item.title: Rendimientos bonos del Tesoro EEUU a 10 años caen, retornos a dos años cambian de tendencia y suben
item.description: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo bajaban el martes mientras los inversionistas seguían de cerca los mercados de bonos europeos.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew
item.content:encoded: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo bajaban el martes mientras los inversionistas seguían de cerca los mercados de bonos europeos. En tanto, los retornos a dos años cambiaron de tendencia y pasaron a terreno positivo antes de la publicación de datos clave sobre la inflación en Estados Unidos. Tras el cierre el lunes por feriado del mercado estadounidense de bonos, los rendimientos a 10 años alcanzaban el martes sus niveles más bajos desde el 2 de octubre, tras registrar la semana pasada su máximo en 24 años. En el extranjero, los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona del euro, especialmente los de mayor vencimiento, bajaban, ya que la liquidación de acciones tecnológicas en Asia llevó a algunos inversionistas a refugiarse en la deuda pública. "Una de las razones por las que el mercado estadounidense se mantenía más o menos estable era lo que está ocurriendo en Europa. Y parece que, en general, simplemente estamos siguiendo las tasas europeas", afirmó Tom di Galoma, director general de Mischler Financial. Los inversionistas estadounidenses esperaban el reporte del índice de precios al consumo de septiembre que se publicará el miércoles para conocer la evolución de la inflación, que se ha mantenido elevada debido a que la guerra en Oriente Medio ha impulsado el precio del petróleo. Sin embargo, los precios del crudo caían el martes, un día después de que el Brent alcanzara su máximo en casi un mes, mientras los operadores seguían de cerca los ataques contra Arabia Saudita y las perspectivas de un suministro adicional de gasóleo procedente de Rusia. A dos semanas de la reunión del 27 y 28 de octubre, los operadores apostaban a que la Fed mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios y deje su próxima subida para diciembre. La probabilidad implícita de un alza en octubre se situaba en 21,6%, mientras que las apuestas por un aumento de 25 puntos básicos en diciembre estaban en 68%, según FedWatch. El rendimiento de los bonos de referencia de Estados Unidos a 10 años caía 2,29 puntos básicos hasta el 5,221%, mientras que el del bono a 30 años cedía 3,19 puntos básicos, hasta el 5,5671%. El rendimiento de los bonos a 2 años , que suele evolucionar en consonancia con las expectativas de tasas de interés de la Fed, subía 1,91 puntos básicos hasta el 4,81%, tras cotizar antes en mínimos de 4,7574%. El diferencial entre los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a dos y 10 años , considerado un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situaba en 40,9 puntos básicos positivos.

item.title: Brazil announces bill to forgive $2.5 billion in micro-entrepreneurs debt
item.description: Brazil announced on Tuesday it would send a bill to Congress aimed at forgiving micro-entrepreneurs' debt with the government, adding it seeks to tackle about 12.6 billion reais ($2.51 billion) in debt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil announced on Tuesday it would send a bill to Congress aimed at forgiving micro-entrepreneurs' debt with the government, adding it seeks to tackle about 12.6 billion reais ($2.51 billion) in debt. The government said in a statement it was also launching a program to purchase micro-entrepreneurs' debt with the private sector. Micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs) make up a simplified Brazilian business category created by the government to formalize self-employed workers, such as food delivery and rideshare drivers, and small business owners The government said debt forgiveness would reach some 3.6 million MEIs, while the purchase program would seek to buy about 6 billion reais in debt with discounts of at least 90% The measures aim at creating conditions for the expansion of the economic activities of MEIs, it added The announcement comes less than two weeks before the presidential election runoff, with President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva [USN:L1N45U128 TEXT:"behind in polls"] against Senator Flavio Bolsonaro "No one wants to be a MEI their whole life, people want to grow; It is up to the government to provide the conditions," Lula said at a ceremony to announce the measures on Tuesday ($1 = 5.0103 reais)

item.title: Adani's Mumbai airport holds off on winter flight cuts after airline pushback
item.description: Adani's Mumbai airport will not alter any airline slots during the winter schedule, a spokesperson said on Tuesday, holding off on international flight cuts planned in the coming weeks after pushback from carriers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Adani's Mumbai airport will not alter any airline slots during the winter schedule, a spokesperson said on Tuesday, holding off on international flight cuts planned in the coming weeks [USN:L4N45Z0CY TEXT:"after pushback"] from carriers. The airport and airlines have been at odds over plans to temporarily cut international flights to make way for the partial demolition of an ageing terminal, Reuters earlier reported. Adani Airports' Director Jeet Adani and CEO Arun Bansal had met with the Airline Operators Committee of Mumbai, the spokesperson said, and assured airlines that historic slot allocations would be fully respected The spokesperson cited commitments from airlines to support the rebalancing of traffic starting from the summer schedule. The AOC did not immediately respond to a request for comment A joint working group will draw up an implementation plan over the next two weeks, and the two sides will meet again on October 28 Mumbai International Airport had proposed a 33% cut in international departure slots to make room at Terminal 2 for about 5 million passengers moving from Terminal 1, emails reviewed by Reuters showed The AOC said in an October 2 letter that the proposal was "not accepted"

item.title: Azerbaijan's governing party defends school uniform rules after hijab dispute
item.description: Azerbaijan defended on Tuesday its decision to introduce school uniform rules that have led to protests over restrictions on Islamic headscarves, and told close ally Turkey to stay out of its domestic affairs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Azerbaijan defended on Tuesday its decision to introduce school uniform rules that have led to protests over restrictions on Islamic headscarves, and told close ally Turkey to stay out of its domestic affairs. Azerbaijan, whose constitution separates religion from the state and guarantees freedom of religion, is a secular former Soviet republic with a predominantly Muslim population. The dispute threatens to strain relations between Azerbaijan and Turkey, and highlights the challenges Baku faces in enforcing secularism. The government introduced rules last month that prohibit school pupils from wearing clothing that departs from the official school uniform or is incompatible with the secular character of state education. The rules do not explicitly mention the hijab, but some protests broke out this week after reports that some pupils and teachers wearing Islamic headscarves were being denied entry to schools. The Interior Ministry said on Monday that 37 people had been detained for disrupting public order while opposing enforcement of the rules. The governing Yeni Azerbaijan Party (YAP) on Tuesday criticised an adviser to Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and lawmakers from Turkey's ruling AK Party for speaking out against Azerbaijan's new rules. The adviser, Oktay Saral, wrote on X on Monday that it was "unacceptable" to deny the right to an education to Azerbaijani students who wear headscarves. "A headscarf is not an obstacle; it is a requirement of religious belief," he said. "We expect Azerbaijan to reverse this mistake as soon as possible." In a statement, YAP condemned Saral's comments as "populist and irresponsible" and said they risked harming relations between the close allies, adding that the new rules were based on equality, secularism and the rule of law. It said Turkey was also constitutionally secular and warned Ankara against using Azerbaijan's education policies for political purposes. The principle of "one nation, two states" — used to describe the countries' close ties — did not justify interference in each other's domestic affairs or the imposition of political and ideological views, YAP said. It also rejected criticism of Azerbaijan's close relations with Israel, saying they were based on international law and mutual interests.

item.title: Bloqueo puertos marítimos limitará exportaciones maíz Ucrania en campaña 2026/27 a 19 mln tn: agricultores
item.description: Es poco probable que las exportaciones de maíz ucranianas superen los 18 ó 19 millones de toneladas métricas en la temporada 2026/27, frente a los al menos 22 millones de toneladas de la temporada 2025/26, debido al bloqueo de los principales puertos del Mar Negro, según informó el martes la Unión de Agricultores de Ucrania (UAC).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Es poco probable que las exportaciones de maíz ucranianas superen los 18 ó 19 millones de toneladas métricas en la temporada 2026/27, frente a los al menos 22 millones de toneladas de la temporada 2025/26, debido al bloqueo de los principales puertos del Mar Negro, según informó el martes la Unión de Agricultores de Ucrania (UAC). La mayor parte de la carga ucraniana, incluido el cereal, se ha desviado a través de los tres puertos del país situados en el río Danubio desde que los ataques rusos bloquearon de hecho sus puertos del Mar Negro en la región de Odesa, que anteriormente gestionaban el 90% de las exportaciones Ucrania no puede exportar más de 1,5 millones de toneladas de maíz al mes, según el sindicato El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA) prevé que las exportaciones de maíz ucraniano alcancen unos 22 millones de toneladas en 2026/27, mientras que la consultora agrícola APK-Inform ha pronosticado exportaciones de 20 millones de toneladas Es probable que Ucrania coseche unos 32 millones de toneladas de maíz en 2026, frente a los 31 millones de toneladas de 2025 Ucrania ha exportado 2 millones de toneladas de maíz en lo que va de la campaña 2026/27, según datos del Ministerio de Agricultura

item.title: Report: Pats RB TreVeyon Henderson out multiple weeks
item.description: New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson will be sidelined multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain, ESPN reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson will be sidelined multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain, ESPN reported on Tuesday. Henderson will not require surgery for the injury sustained in the first half of Sunday's 45-17 home victory against the Las Vegas Raiders, and he is regarded as a "quick healer," per the report. The Patriots (3-2) likely will lean more heavily on starter Rhamondre Stevenson for Sunday's AFC East clash with the New York Jets (2-3) in Foxborough, Mass. New England also has second-year running back Corey Kiner on the roster. Henderson gained 22 yards on four carries and had one catch for 16 yards before departing with the right ankle injury. He has 163 rushing yards and one touchdown in four games this season. A second-round pick out of Ohio State in 2025, Henderson has rushed for 1,074 yards and 10 touchdowns and caught 37 passes for 243 yards and one score in 21 career games (four starts). --Field Level Media

item.title: Botswana nearing deal to raise De Beers stake to about 25%, Bloomberg reports
item.description: The preferred bidder for diamond producer De Beers, the Global Diamond Consortium, is nearing an agreement with Botswana that could increase the government's stake to about 25%, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The preferred bidder for diamond producer De Beers, the Global Diamond Consortium, is nearing an agreement with Botswana that could increase the government's stake to about 25%, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. Reuters could not independently verify the report. Global Diamond Consortium, led by former De Beers CEO Gareth Penny, was named [USN:L8N43J0T4 TEXT:"preferred bidder"] in July Anglo American (AAL.L) put De Beers [USN:L1N42O0E4 TEXT:"up for sale"] in May 2024 as part of a broader restructuring amid weak diamond prices and growing competition from synthetic diamonds Botswana already owns 15% of De Beers Namibia, Angola and private buyers have also shown interest in the business

item.title: Report: Gianni Infantino received undisclosed $1.7M World Cup payment
item.description: Embattled FIFA president Gianni Infantino received a previously undisclosed $1.72 million World Cup payment, according to FIFA and IRS documents obtained by ESPN.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Embattled FIFA president Gianni Infantino received a previously undisclosed $1.72 million World Cup payment, according to FIFA and IRS documents obtained by ESPN. According to the report published on Tuesday, the lack of transparency surrounding the compensation is a potential violation of FIFA statutes. Infantino received the compensation in 2024 from FWC2026, the official U.S.-based organization set up by FIFA to manage and operate the 2026 World Cup held this summer in North America, according to IRS records. The $1.72 million was in addition to Infantino's salary and benefits from FIFA for 2024, which amounted to about $4.9 million. The additional compensation was not disclosed in FIFA's annual report in 2024, per the report. According to FIFA's own statutes, "The individual compensation of the FIFA President, the members of the Council and the FIFA Secretary General shall be made public." A FIFA spokesperson told ESPN that the organization "strongly rejects any suggestion there has been a violation" of the statutes. "FIFA does not pay a second salary to the FIFA President and complies with all reporting requirements in relation to compensation," read a FIFA statement. "The FIFA President's annual compensation, as well as other contractual benefits, are decided by the independent Compensation Sub-Committee. "FIFA strongly rejects any claims that it has failed to disclose any financial information and has violated FIFA's Statutes. FIFA accounts are independently audited, and all declarations are in line with tax regulations in Switzerland, the United States and elsewhere. "FIFA is fully focused on the FIFA Council meeting on Thursday and looks forward to discussions with its members to further grow the game following the most successful FIFA World Cup in history." It is the latest controversy surrounding Infantino, 56, who has been in office since 2016. Earlier this year, he came under fire for a since-aborted plan to sell a 20% stake in the World Cup to private investors. --Field Level Media

item.title: Own goal keeps Kashima Antlers perfect in Asian Champions League
item.description: Kashima Antlers earned a 1-0 win over Vietnamese hosts Cong An Ha Noi thanks to a own goal on Tuesday to move top of the table in the eastern league phase of the Asian Champions League Elite.
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Kashima Antlers earned a 1-0 win over Vietnamese hosts Cong An Ha Noi thanks to a own goal on Tuesday to move top of the table in the eastern league phase of the Asian Champions League Elite. Nguyen Adou Leygley Minh's own goal in the 61st minute kept the J-League champions perfect after Toru Oniki's side started their campaign by thrashing Newcastle Jets last month. Kashima lead compatriots Gamba Osaka, who also secured a second win in a row when Tomokazu Myojin's team came back from a goal behind to win 3-1 against Newcastle in Australia. Nikos Vergos gave the Jets a 32nd-minute lead with a heavily deflected strike from the edge of the area but Yusei Toshida's header eight minutes later levelled the scores. Deniz Hummet, who scored the winner when Gamba beat Saudi Arabia's Al-Nassr to claim last season's Asian Champions League Two title, hit the decisive second with 17 minutes remaining and Welton Felipe rounded out the win with a late third. Fabio Abreu's 79th minute header earned Beijing Guoan a 1-0 win over hosts Buriram United in Thailand as the Chinese Super League outfit also secured their second successive victory. Japan's Kyoto Sanga defeated Ratchaburi from Thailand 1-0 to pick up their first three points of the campaign through Temma Matsuda's 88th minute volley while Shanghai Port were held to a 1-1 draw by Daejeon Citizen. Prince Ampem had given hosts Shanghai a 49th-minute lead but Diogo Oliveira headed in from close range five minutes later to earn the South Korean side a share of the points. Marcos Guilherme scored twice as Malaysian champions Johor Darul Ta'zim took advantage of Pohang Steelers midfielder Jeon Min-gwang's sending off just before the break to win 2-0. Guilherme put the visitors ahead four minutes after the restart before sealing the points for Xisco Munoz's side with his second a minute from time. The first eight finishers in the 16-team league phase in both east and west Asia will advance to the knockout rounds of the competition, with the tournament's quarter-finals, semi-finals and final to be played in Saudi Arabia next April.

item.title: Houthis relatam ataque a instalação petrolífera no Iêmen após ordem de retirada da coalizão saudita
item.description: A emissora Al-Masirah TV, controlada pelos houthis, noticiou na terça-feira um ataque à Companhia de Petróleo do Iêmen, em Sanaa.

item.content:encoded: A emissora Al-Masirah TV, controlada pelos houthis, noticiou na terça-feira um ataque à Companhia de Petróleo do Iêmen, em Sanaa. O suposto ataque ocorreu logo após a coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita ter ordenado a retirada das instalações antes de uma operação militar.

item.title: Fitch warns bond yield surge is worsening debt outlook for developed economies
item.description: Rising government bond yields are making it much harder for major developed economies to stabilise debt burdens, with countries including France, the US and Britain facing growing fiscal challenges, credit rating agency Fitch said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rising government bond yields are making it much harder for major developed economies to stabilise debt burdens, with countries including France, the US and Britain facing growing fiscal challenges, credit rating agency Fitch said on Tuesday. In a report, Fitch said benchmark 10-year government bond yields in the world's 10 largest developed economies had risen by an average of 81 basis points so far this year. That would contribute to a nearly $4 trillion increase in overall developed-market government debt, taking it above $75 trillion, or $68.5 trillion across the top 10 economies. The median 10-year yield across the largest developed economies is now 161 bps above the average interest rate paid on outstanding debt, making it harder to reduce or even stabilise debt levels France faces one of the steepest challenges. It would need to cut its primary deficit to 0.4% of GDP from a projected 2.9% this year to stabilise its debt burden, while a rise in effective borrowing costs to current market yields would require a further fiscal adjustment of about 3.1% of GDP The US is expected to run the largest general government budget deficit this year, at 7.5% of GDP, or $2.4 trillion, followed by France (5.4%), the UK (4.8%) and Germany (3.7%) Deficits are expected to widen the most this year in Germany, by 1.1 percentage points, followed by the US and Canada, both by 0.7pp, and to narrow the most in Britain, by 0.4pp By 2030, debt-to-GDP ratios are forecast to rise most in France, by 12pp to 128%, followed by the US and Germany. Japan's ratio is expected to fall 11pp to 185%.

item.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying
item.description: Russia's Federal Security Service said it detained a Japanese journalist accused of gathering information on Russia's defence capabilities, news agencies reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russia's Federal Security Service said it detained a Japanese journalist accused of gathering information on Russia's defence capabilities, news agencies reported on Tuesday. FSB said the journalist for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper had been detained in the far eastern Sakhalin region before he planned to leave Russia, and was subsequently transferred to custody in Moscow, Interfax reported. Russian state TV showed a man lying on a floor and handcuffed by three masked men in black uniform. A voice behind the scene tells him he is suspected of spying. TV also showed him boarding a plane accompanied by two FSB servicemen, then in a cage on trial in a Moscow court, which authorised his custody for nearly two months. Russia regards Japan as an [USN:L8N3ZG0NU TEXT:""unfriendly" country"] as it has joined Western sanctions against Moscow over the war in Ukraine. Japan's embassy in Moscow did not answer phone calls out of business hours. Russia and Japan never signed a formal World War Two peace treaty, with the main obstacle being an unresolved territorial dispute over the Kuril Islands, known in Japan as the Northern Territories. Russian President Vladimir Putin [USN:L8N44F0CG TEXT:"visited"] one of the disputed islands in August, causing an uproar in Japan. Tokyo has said it would continue implementing sanctions against Russia and supporting Ukraine. One of the most prominent cases of a foreign journalist arrested in Russia was the detention of Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich in 2023. He was found guilty of espionage by a Russian court, sentenced to 16 years and then freed in an East-West prisoner swap in August 2024.

item.title: Boeing delivers 57 jets in September, highest monthly total for year
item.description: Boeing said on Tuesday that it delivered 57 jets in September, up from 51 in August and 55 a year earlier as it works to ramp up production of its best-selling 737 MAX narrow-body. It was the planemaker's highest monthly total so far this year.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Boeing (BA.N) said on Tuesday that it delivered 57 jets in September, up from 51 in August and 55 a year earlier as it works to ramp up production of its best-selling 737 MAX narrow-body. It was the planemaker's highest monthly total so far this year. Turkish Airlines' order for [USN:L6N45F0ZB TEXT:"100 737 MAX jets"] boosted Boeing's September total of new orders to 165. The US planemaker still trailed European rival Airbus' [USN:L1N45U0QJ TEXT:"72 deliveries"] in September, but Boeing far outsold its rival, which booked only 17 new orders from two customers last month. Boeing's September deliveries included 43 737 MAX jets, eight 787s, two 777 freighters and four 767s, including three for Boeing's defense unit for completion as KC-46 aerial refueling tankers. The higher deliveries come as Boeing works to consistently increase 737 MAX output to 47 jets a month, which has taken [USN:L6N45813N TEXT:"longer than expected"], Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg said during an investor conference in September. Through September, Boeing has delivered 475 jets this year, up 8% from a year earlier. That includes 363 737 MAX jets, the most the MAX program has ever delivered in the first nine months of a year. In addition to Turkish Airlines' order, Boeing booked orders for 20 737 MAX jets for Lufthansa, six 737 MAX and five 787 jets for Biman Bangladesh Airlines, and eight 777-8 freighters and two 777 freighters for Ethiopian Airlines. Another six 737 MAX and 18 787 orders came from unidentified customers. Boeing ended September with an official backlog of 6,371 jets, up from 6,156 at the end of August.

item.title: Monedas bajan pese a retroceso global del dólar, en espera de datos cruciales de EEUU
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban pérdidas el partes, a pesar de un retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales, mientras la atención de los mercados comienza a centrarse en datos de la economía de Estados Unidos, cruciales para evaluar los futuros movimientos de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal (Fed).
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina anotaban pérdidas el partes, a pesar de un retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales, mientras la atención de los mercados comienza a centrarse en datos de la economía de Estados Unidos, cruciales para evaluar los futuros movimientos de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal (Fed). * Para el miércoles se espera que se de a conocer el IPC de Estados Unidos de septiembre, previo al dato del índice de precios al productor y las ventas minoristas un día después, para concluir la semana con la intervención del presidente de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, en el FMI el viernes. * [USN:L6N45Z0PF TEXT:"El gobernador"] de la Reserva Federal Christopher Waller dijo el martes que el reciente aumento del rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense refleja un mayor crecimiento económico más que unas mayores expectativas de inflación, que siguen "bien ancladas". * Los operadores ven ahora solo un 17% de probabilidades de que la Fed suba las tasas este mes, mientras que la posibilidad de un alza en diciembre asciende al 87%, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde ante una canasta de seis importantes monedas, retrocedía alrededor de un 0,3%, en consonancia con el descenso de los precios del petróleo y luego que, en la víspera, la divisa estadounidense alcanzara un máximo de 18 meses. * En tanto, el Fondo Monetario Internacional recortó en la víspera sus previsiones de crecimiento para América Latina y el Caribe para 2026 y 2027, y dijo que la mayor parte de la región está recibiendo poco impulso del auge de la inteligencia artificial que ha ayudado a otras economías a absorber el choque energético de la guerra en Oriente Medio. * El peso mexicano cotizaba en 18,3810 por dólar, con una caída del 0,70%, reanudando una racha de pérdidas que había interrumpido en la víspera, mientras los inversionistas evaluaban señales sobre el futuro del diferencial de tasas entre México y Estados Unidos, con la mira puesta en la trayectoria monetaria de la Reserva Federal. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía un 0,43%, a 67.034,18 unidades, impulsado principalmente por firmas del sector financiero, mientras Wall Street abría a la baja al inicio de la temporada de resultados corporativos en Estados Unidos, que incluye a grandes bancos. * El real brasileño se depreciaba un 0,56%, a 5,0140 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo retrocedía un 0,99%, a 206.989,12 puntos. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista cedía un leve 0,13% a 1.519 por dólar ARS=RASL, en momentos en que el banco central (BCRA) busca sumar divisas a diario para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. * Con la idea de cubrir vencimientos de deuda interna a corto plazo, el Tesoro argentino realizará el miércoles su primera licitación mensual, una movida habitual debido a que tiene cerrada la posibilidad de financiamiento externo por los altos costos a pagar. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires subía un 0,9% y los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles promediaban una ganancia del 0,2%, junto a un riesgo país con algo más de oxígeno en los 589 puntos básicos. * El peso chileno , subía un ligero 0,04%, a 981,50/981,80 por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , avanzaba un 0,13%, a 11.057,54 unidades. * El peso colombiano ganaba un 0,28% a 3.180 unidades por dólar y en la bolsa el índice accionario COLCAP (.COLCAP) subía un 0,42% a 2.541,70 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreciaba un mínimo 0,03% a 3,4410/3,4420 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdía un 0,20% a 1.591,90 puntos.

item.description: LONDON, Oct 13 : Human rights campaigners Amnesty International accused Formula One of hollow words and offering Rwanda a "sportswashing prize" with a 10-year African Grand Prix deal announced on Tuesday.The landmark deal envisages a race sometime in the early 2030s, at a circuit that has yet to be built near

Amnesty accuses F1 of offering Rwanda a 'sportswashing prize' with race deal

LONDON, Oct 13 : Human rights campaigners Amnesty International accused Formula One of hollow words and offering Rwanda a "sportswashing prize" with a 10-year African Grand Prix deal announced on Tuesday. The landmark deal envisages a race sometime in the early 2030s, at a circuit that has yet to be built near a new international airport to the south of Kigali. It will be the first race in Africa since 1993. "A 10-year Grand Prix 'presented by Visit Rwanda' is a sportswashing prize for the Rwandan authorities," said Felix Jakens, Amnesty UK's head of campaigns in a written response. "Arsenal, Aston Villa, the cycling world championships and now Formula One - Rwanda is buying into the world's biggest sports to polish its image and deflect from its appalling human rights record.

"Formula One says sport can be 'a positive force for good'. That rings hollow if F1 shrugs off who it is partnering with. Rwanda's authorities are prolific in arbitrary detention, torture and the repression of free speech – these are abuses at home." The Rwandan government did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The allegation of "sportswashing" is levelled at countries perceived to be using sport to improve a tarnished image abroad. Several other Formula One hosts, mainly in the Middle East, have been accused of it. Premier League side Aston Villa's sponsorship agreement with Visit Rwanda drew similar criticism from human rights campaigners last July. The African nation's tourism board also has sponsorship agreements with Atletico Madrid and Paris St Germain, as well as US sports teams including the Los Angeles Clippers and Los Angeles Rams. It had branding on Arsenal's shirt sleeves for eight seasons. Rwanda's President Paul Kagame has won praise from Western and regional leaders for helping to end the 1994 genocide in Rwanda and rebuilding the country into an attractive destination for investment and aid. He also stands accused of a crackdown on critics at home, and supporting the M23 rebel group in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo, who rights groups say are guilty of killings, rapes and other rights abuses. Kagame told a press conference in Kigali that the deal would set Rwanda on a journey "that will change how Africa is perceived in the world of sport". "We are looking at Rwanda in the context of a continent," he added. A Formula One spokesperson said the sport had "the opportunity to inspire and bring the passion of F1 to 100 million people across Africa and sport can be a positive force for good."  Jakens urged Formula One to push for change "rather than lend its brand to a PR exercise."

Source: Reuters

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナのエネルギー施設攻撃せず トランプ氏「停戦」発表後初
item.description:
Olena Harmash Daniel Flynn
[キーウ １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olena Harmash　Daniel Flynn

[キーウ　１３日　ロイター] - ロシアは１３日、トランプ米大統領が週末の間に「エネルギー停戦」を発表して以来初めて、ウクライナのエネルギー関連施設への攻撃を実施しなかった。ただ、ウクライナ各地の輸送・物流インフラを標的にした攻撃は続けた。

トランプ米大統領は１１日、ロシアとウクライナが双方のエネルギー関連施設への攻撃停止で「合意した」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿。即時発効するとしたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。ロシア大統領報道官はこの件について協議は続けられていると述べるにとどめ、詳細な説明は避けているが、 ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１３日、トランプ米大統領が「エネルギー停戦」を発表したことを受け、ロシアの製油所などのエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を２日間停止したと明らかにしていた。

ロシア国防省は１３日に公表した夜間攻撃に関する日次報告でウクライナのエネルギー施設に対する攻撃について言及していない。ただ、今回の攻撃でロシアがエネルギーインフラを意図的に攻撃対象から外したかどうかは現時点では明らかになっていない。

＜輸送・物流インフラへの攻撃続く＞

ウクライナ空軍は１３日、夜間のロシア軍による攻撃で国内１７カ所で被害が確認されたと明らかにした。防空部隊がロシア軍のドローン（無人機）１０８機のうち８８機を撃墜したとしている。

西部リビウで市内の大部分に熱供給を行う施設から１キロ余り離れた場所にミサイル１発が着弾したほか、南部ミコライウ州では貨物ターミナルが被害を受け、南東部ドニプロペトロフスク州では輸送インフラが損傷した。ウクライナ第２の都市ハリコフでは集合住宅への攻撃により４人が死亡し、少なくとも１１人が負傷した。西部フメリニツキー州では病院が被害を受けた。

ウクライナ空軍は、ロシアが１２日夜に首都キーウに向けて弾道ミサイル６発を発射した際、事前の監視・警戒情報がなかったと表明。空軍は声明で「原因を調査している」としている。

ロイターなどは、米当局者がウクライナに対しロシアの製油所への攻撃を停止しなければ、情報共有や武器売却を打ち切る可能性があると警告したと報道。ただ、ウクライナのシビハ外相はこの日、ウクライナは米国から引き続き情報提供を受けていると表明。ワルシャワ安全保障フォーラムで「ウクライナと米国は協力を継続している」と述べた。

item.title: Walmart to offer 250-plus free medications, including GLP-1s, to employees
item.description: Walmart on Tuesday introduced a plan to offer employees more than 250 medications, including GLP-1s, insulin and inhalers at no cost, as the retailer expands healthcare benefits for its workforce.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Walmart (WMT.O) on Tuesday introduced a plan to offer employees more than 250 medications, including GLP-1s, insulin and inhalers at no cost, as the retailer expands healthcare benefits for its workforce. Here are some details: The largest U.S. private employer, with about 1.6 million domestic workers, is in its annual enrollment season, which runs through Nov. 6. The plan covers treatment at providers such as Mayo Clinic for serious conditions including cancer, plus free GLP-1s for associates with type 2 diabetes. Surging healthcare expenses have been adding pressure on Americans who are already facing rising costs of living from inflation and oil prices. "We're adding even more ways to help you and your family live better through comprehensive and affordable healthcare and benefits," Chief People Officer Donna Morris said in a memo. Associates evaluated for or diagnosed with conditions, including multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease, will get no-cost specialist evaluations, the company said. Walmart, however, would raise starting health insurance premiums by $1.50 per biweekly pay period to $39.80, according to its website. The retailer already offers benefits including 20 no-cost therapy sessions annually and up to $20,000 for fertility, adoption or surrogacy services.

item.title: 米中古住宅販売、9月は予想外の1.5％増 住宅ローン金利上昇で先行き懸念も
item.description: [ワシントン １３日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１３日発表した９月の米中古住宅販売戸数（季節調整済...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米中古住宅販売、9月は予想外の1.5％増　住宅ローン金利上昇で先行き懸念も 10/13 23:43 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの住宅に掲げられた「売家」の看板。１月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ワシントン　１３日　ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１３日発表した９月の米中古住宅販売戸数（季節調整済み）は年率換算で前月比１．５％増の３９９万戸だった。在庫の増加により買い手の選択肢が広がったことから予想（３９５万戸）に反して増加した。ただ、住宅ローン金利の上昇を背景に伸びは依然として鈍い。

９月は前年同月比では２．２％減少した。

地域別では、南部と西部で増加した一方、北東部では減少し、中西部では横ばいだった。

ＮＡＲのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「季節調整済みベースでは前月比で小幅な増加が見られたものの、８月と９月は今年に入って住宅販売が最も低調な２カ月となった」と指摘。「ここ数週間の住宅ローン金利の一段の上昇により、住宅購入の資格を満たせる買い手は減少している」と述べた。

中古住宅の在庫は１．９％増の１６０万戸と、２０１９年１１月以来の高水準となった。前年同月比では４．６％増加した。

９月の販売ペースに基づく在庫の消化期間は４．８カ月と、前月から横ばいだったが、前年同月（４．５カ月）の水準を上回った。

中古住宅価格の中央値は前年同月比１．３％上昇の４１万７５００ドルと、同月としては過去最高となった。初めて住宅を購入する人の割合は全体の３１％と、前月および前年同月の３０％から上昇した。

住宅が市場に出ていた期間の中央値は３３日。前月の３１日からは延びたものの、前年同月からは横ばいとなった。

差し押さえ物件を含む不良債権売却は取引全体の２％と、変わらずだった。

現金のみによる販売の割合は２７％と前月から横ばい。前年同月は３０％だった。

item.description: Oct 13 : Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said on Tuesday that inflation is starting to feel like "aggregate overheating" fueled by spillovers from the artificial intelligence investment boom rather than largely being a byproduct of supply shocks that will pass on its own."This is sta

Goolsbee says AI-induced inflation is 'jumping out of its lane,' Semafor reports

FILE PHOTO: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee is interviewed on the sidelines of the Kansas City Fed's annual economic symposium, in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, U.S. August 27, 2026. REUTERS/Ann Saphir/File Photo

FAST

Oct 13 : Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee said on Tuesday that inflation is starting to feel like "aggregate overheating" fueled by spillovers from the artificial intelligence investment boom rather than largely being a byproduct of supply shocks that will pass on its own. "This is starting to feel like aggregate overheating, that the AI data center cost increases are jumping out of its lane, that prices are going up in spaces that are not just components in data centers and the directly adjacent industries to data centers," Goolsbee said in a Semafor interview. "If you start to see more of this spreading into general services, that investment goods are just getting GDP (gross domestic product) growth up faster than potential and generating this kind of spillover inflation, that’s problematic because unlike supply shocks where we tend to assume they’re going to go away on their own in a relatively short period of time, nobody thinks that of overheating demand." "It takes a long time for overheated demand to get going, and once it’s going, it’s hard to get rid of that," Goolsbee said. "So that’s why the conventional wisdom among economists has been if you see overheating demand, you act decisively and you act quickly to prevent that from rolling into inflation expectations, rolling into people taking for granted that it’s never going to go away." Asked whether the Fed should continue raising interest rates, Goolsbee, who does not have a vote on rate policy this year, said: "So if inflation remains persistent, then I think it’s clear what the Fed has to do. If we can get some evidence that this tariff inflation is going away, that the oil shock inflation is going away, it’s not too much progress that we need to show, but we need to start showing some progress if we’re going to get back on the kind of rate cutting path that we were on." The Fed cut rates three times in 2025 but last month raised rates for the first time in three years in the face of stubborn inflation, bumping its short-term policy rate up by a quarter percentage point to a range of 3.75 per cent-4.00 per cent. Rate futures markets expect it will forego another increase at the coming October 27-28 meeting but will lift rates by another quarter point in December.

Source: Reuters

KIGALI, Oct 13 : Rwanda's Formula One circuit will be fast and flowing with a lot of elevation changes and spectators able to get close to the action, designers said on Tuesday after the announcement of a 10-year deal for the first African Grand Prix since 1993. The circuit, alongside a new international airport under construction at Bugesera some 40 km (25 miles) south of the capital Kigali, has yet to be built and is not expected to host a race until the early 2030s. Carsten Tilke, managing partner of the Tilke company founded by his father Hermann that has built circuits around the world, told a press conference that the track would unfold between two hills offering a natural grandstand and alongside a lake. "We can bring the spectators very close," he said. "The drivers will love the track because it has so much elevation going up and down, high bankings. It will be very fast, flowing and really integrated in nature.

"We go very close to the lake with fast corner combinations" Tilke said the paddock would be terraced, using the natural topography and inspired by local villages and cultures. Designer and former racer Alex Wurz said the proposed layout was like a roller-coaster and truly unique, with an elevation gain of 197 metres (646 feet) over the course of a lap.
